name: audio-plugin-ux
description: Evidence-based reasoning and layout generation for desktop audio-plugin interaction, focus, control placement, state, and constrained host surfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Reason from hearing work before drawing controls.
interface.longDescription: Studies an audio plug-in as a stateful instrument rather than a web page. Produces evidence-tagged focus, visibility, control-placement, state, and constrained-layout reasoning before UI changes.
defaultPrompt: Audit this audio-plugin UI before changing it.
Explain why each primary control belongs where it is.
Build a visibility matrix for this plugin workflow.
Derive a layout hypothesis from this parameter inventory and fixed host surface.
